name: Macau
summary: A green field with a white lotus flower above a stylised Governador Nobre de Carvalho Bridge and water, under an arc of five yellow stars. It was raised when Portugal handed Macau to China on 20 December 1999.
origin: Under Portuguese rule, Macau used the Portuguese flag. The current flag was adopted by the National People's Congress in 1993 for the handover in 1999.

symbols.name: Lotus
symbols.description: A white lotus flower with three petals.
symbols.meaning: Macau's floral emblem; the three petals represent the Macau peninsula, Taipa and Coloane.

symbols.name: Bridge and water
symbols.description: A stylised bridge above wavy lines.
symbols.meaning: The Governador Nobre de Carvalho Bridge and the sea surrounding Macau.

symbols.name: Five stars
symbols.description: One large and four small yellow stars in an arc.
symbols.meaning: Echo the national flag of China, showing Macau as part of China.

facts: Macau was the last European colony in Asia, handed over in 1999.
Its green field is unusual for a Chinese flag.
Hong Kong's flag also echoes China's five stars.
clues: Green with a white lotus over a bridge and water, under five yellow stars.
Raised in 1999 when the last European colony in Asia was handed over.
Its lotus's three petals stand for three areas of land.
